basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a software engineering student from Sydney, Australia, diving into the world of Reddit. I have a keen interest in blockchain and cryptocurrencies, which is why I recently started using Atomic Wallet. Apart from tech, I enjoy playing Roblox and am a big fan of the Jurassic World series. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, after classes or work. I'm currently single and juggling my studies with a part-time job at a local tech startup.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge in software engineering gained through my university studies and some personal projects. I am particularly interested in blockchain technology, which I have been exploring through online courses and forums.
